signal_sampling: Exact-N multinomial from full-selected native MC histogram CDF, analysis bins plus below/above-support categories; histogram overflow retained in above-support category. Equivalent to independent histogram draws and uniform within source bins. No additional smearing, shifting, cuts or interpolation between masses.
yield_parameter: Full-selected candidate yield N. S_i=p_i on full-selected normalization; fitted subset never renormalized. Actual support/window draws saved.

methods.pole_centered: fit and external-training mask m +/- 2.25 sigma_nominal(m)
methods.core_shifted: fit and external-training mask c_MC(m) +/- 2.25 sigma_nominal(m); unchanged native MC shape

centers: Pinned MC-only local integrated Gaussian plus nonnegative affine pedestal, same definition as v6.1; 260 newly located with identical code. Fixed across all toys and levels.
background_truth: Pinned v5.8.2 nominal2021 all-data GP arithmetic mean, full support, source kernel anchor76MeV; no source uncertainty draw or truth retuning. New Poisson draws, same truth for every mass and both methods.
background_sampling: Independent full Poisson spectra per mass/toy; same background reused at all four injected levels and null; same B+S counts for both extraction methods. Signal draws independent across levels using level-keyed seeds.
GP_training: Retrain mean and full predictive covariance on each injected toy exterior bins with archived mass-dependent kernel hyperparameters fixed; count-dependent targets log(n) and alpha=1/n update. No hyperparameter reoptimization.

diagnostic_controls.clean_sidebands: Predict GP from background-only bins of same toy, fit same injected window counts; simulation-only truth-assisted control
diagnostic_controls.known_background: Fixed true background mean, no GP nuisance; same window counts and template. Simulation-only oracle control

pull: (signed unconstrained Ahat-N)/observed profile-Hessian sigma_A; negative Ahat retained
profile_containment: 2*(profile_nll_at_true_N - free_min_nll) <=1 or chi2_1(.95), nominal68.27% and95% LR sets; recorded counts and Clopper-Pearson95% uncertainty, 40 toys does not calibrate coverage
likelihood: Inherited v6.1 Poisson counts plus correlated Gaussian GP-background constraint; exact-N injected signal actually multinomial, so nominal Poisson intervals and unit pull width are reference diagnostics

extension260.reason: native MC exists beyond archived250MeV extraction grid
extension260.claim: labeled extraction extension, not new scan/domain validation

limitations: Conditional supplied selected MC shape; v13/v16 selection equivalence and signal daughter association unvalidated.
Template and MC center fixed; finite MC and detector-response uncertainties not propagated.
One nominal background truth and 40 toys per cell; no physical coverage, exclusion or discovery claim.
No scan over mass or window selection using toy performance.
